title: EU AI Act GPAI and transparency obligations apply
before: Model governance was voluntary commitments and self-published system cards.
problem: No binding requirement to disclose training data summaries, label AI output or document systemic risk.
breakthrough: Binding obligations for general-purpose models and Article 50 transparency rules, with fines up to 3% of global turnover.
why: The first enforceable general AI regime in a major market, though the Digital Omnibus proposes delaying parts of it.
next: A grace period into December 2026 for some marking obligations, and continuing amendment.
inherits: Compliance as a design constraint on deployed models.
